note.summary:
1.3 Education and work
Key focus
- school subjects, lessons, teachers, study routines and future careers.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Distinguish present habits from completed past actions and future intentions; make comparisons accurately.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: La mia materia preferita è la scienza perché gli esperimenti sono interessanti.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
La mia materia preferita è la scienza perché gli esperimenti sono interessanti. Martedì ho consegnato un compito di storia in ritardo. Studio in biblioteca due ore al giorno prima degli esami. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: My favourite subject is science because the experiments are interesting. On Tuesday I handed in a history assignment late. I study in the library for two hours a day before exams. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
